name: pod_search
description:
Search pod_store for pod HEADERS (not full bodies). Use this to browse candidate pods, then call pod_fetch on the pod_ids you want to open.

Pods are retrievable memory units about the user.

WHEN THE USER ASKS ABOUT A SPECIFIC TOPIC / PERSON / CONVERSATION: use `query` with 1-3 content keywords. Do NOT put people or topics in `tags`.

Examples:
- 'conversation with Justin about knowledge graphs' → `query='knowledge graph'` (stem-matched so 'graphs' finds 'graph')
- 'what did I eat yesterday' → `tags=['food'], since='1d'`
- 'creamer discussion' → `query='creamer'`
- 'emails from Acme this week' → `kind='email', query='Acme', since='7d'`
- 'recent invoice emails' → `kind='email', query='invoice', since='2w'`

Parameters:
- `query` (PREFERRED for topic/person/keyword search): substring match over one_liner + body; multi-word queries are tokenized AND-matched with plural stemming.
- `kind`: restrict to one pod kind. Valid: 'chat_cluster', 'email'. Use 'email' to search the user's email pods specifically.
- `tags`: fixed vocabulary ONLY — food, entertainment, health, schedule, work. NEVER invent tag names. (Tags are populated for chat pods only; emails currently have no tags.)
- `since`: '24h', '3d', '2w', '1m', 'today', or ISO timestamp.

IF A SEARCH RETURNS 0 PODS: drop filters and retry — drop tags, try a different query keyword, or expand since. Do NOT give up after one empty result.

inputs.name: query
inputs.description: Free-text substring matched against pod one_liner and body (case-insensitive). Pods with matches in one_liner rank above body-only matches. Use single meaningful words like 'knowledge graph' or 'Justin', not multi-concept queries.

inputs.name: kind
inputs.description: Restrict to one pod kind. Currently 'chat_cluster' or 'email'. When searching the user's mailbox, set kind='email' to skip chat pods.

inputs.name: tags
inputs.description: Fixed taxonomy. Valid values ONLY: food, entertainment, health, schedule, work. OR-match within the list. Example: ['food','health']. For people / topics / keywords, use `query` instead. Tags are populated for chat_cluster pods only — email pods have no tags.

inputs.name: since
inputs.description: Time window shorthand. Accepts '24h', '3d', '2w', '1m', 'today', or an ISO timestamp.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Max number of headers to return. Default 20.

outputs.description: Structured: {count, pods: [{pod_id, tags, one_liner, scope_id, created_at, created_by, content_type}]}.

arguments_prompt:
Arguments for pod_search:
- query (optional): comma-separated search keywords for finding relevant pods
- kind (optional): 'chat_cluster' | 'email' — narrow to one source
- tags (optional): {food, entertainment, health, schedule, work} (chat_cluster pods only)
- since (optional): '24h' / '3d' / '1w' / 'today' / ISO
- limit (optional): default 20
